# Tomba

Tomba is an Email Finder for B2B sales and email marketing.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/tomba/.

## Actions

- **Create Lead**: Add a new lead.
- **Delete API Key by ID**: Delete an api key by id.
- **Delete Leads List by ID**: Delete a leads list by id.
- **List API Keys** (read-only): List all api keys.
- **List Lead Lists** (read-only): List all lead lists.
- **List Leads** (read-only): List all leads.
- **Update Leads List**: Update a leads list's name by id.
- **Domain Status** (read-only): Check if a domain is webmail or disposable.
- **Get Usage Statistics** (read-only): Get api usage statistics.
- **List lead attributes** (read-only): List all lead attributes.
